name: Image Editing
description: Edit only an existing image artifact, and do not invent a replacement.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Find an existing artifact in this session.
Read the same artifact through the read alias.

validation.rule: The source image artifactId was read back first. No edited file is claimed unless a later tool result persists a new artifact that artifact_get reads with size greater than 0.
